body:
Lesson (Termal::Fable2, 2026-11-14 09:35Z), from a w-38a0 ownership race. Fable2 assigned w-38a0's closure to 8e1f while Opus2 had already assigned it to d50d. Withdrawals and reversals then crossed the claim and release in flight, and both sessions churned.

Rules:
(1) Closure and evaluation assignments for landed train members come from ONE source: Opus2, the integration owner. Fable2 rules on the method (admission and criteria), not the assignee, unless Opus2 asks.
(2) To resolve a dispute, read the actual claim holder and fence, then settle on whoever holds it now. Never send a "keep/withdraw" on a remembered state.

Outcome: d50d owns w-38a0 (fence 4) and 8e1f stood down.
